title: Topological complexity of spiked random polynomials and finite-rank spherical integrals
abstract: arXiv:2312.12323v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: We study the annealed complexity of Gaussian random homogeneous polynomials on the $(N-1)$-dimensional unit sphere in the presence of deterministic perturbations depending on fixed orthonormal vectors and external parameters. We derive variational formulas for the exponential asymptotics of the average number of critical points and local maxima. Our approach combines the Kac-Rice formula with determinant asymptotics for finite-rank perturbations of Gaussian Wigner matrices. In particular, the determinant analysis builds on recent results by [Guionnet, Husson 2022] on finite-rank spherical integrals, which we use to establish large deviation estimates for the largest eigenvalue of finite-rank Gaussian Wigner matrices. The resulting variational problems reveal a topological phase transition: above an explicit threshold in the external parameters, new zero-complexity regions emerge, corresponding to critical points with large corr

translated_title: 尖峰随机多项式的拓扑复杂度与有限秩球面积分
translated_abstract: 我们研究了在存在依赖于固定正交向量和外部参数的确定性扰动的情况下，$(N-1)$维单位球面上的高斯随机齐次多项式的退火复杂度。我们推导了临界点和局部极大值平均数的指数渐近的变分公式。我们的方法将Kac-Rice公式与高斯Wigner矩阵有限秩扰动的行列式渐近相结合。特别地，行列式分析基于[Guionnet, Husson 2022]关于有限秩球面积分的最新结果，我们利用这些结果来建立有限秩高斯Wigner矩阵最大特征值的大偏差估计。由此产生的变分问题揭示了拓扑相变：在外部参数中一个显式阈值之上，出现了新的零复杂度区域，对应于具有大相关性的临界点。
tldr: 本文通过结合Kac-Rice公式和有限秩球面积分的最新结果，推导了尖峰随机多项式临界点复杂度的变分公式，并发现了外部参数阈值之上的拓扑相变，导致新的零复杂度区域出现。
en_tdlr: This paper derives variational formulas for the complexity of spiked random polynomials by combining Kac-Rice formula with recent results on finite-rank spherical integrals, revealing a topological phase transition above an explicit threshold in external parameters, where new zero-complexity regions emerge.
